ambient_events: Something unspeakable gurgles down the floor drain and is not discussed.
A regular knocks the bar twice; the bartender pours without looking.
The single TV shows horse racing from a track that no longer exists.
A fly, impossibly, in this cold, orbits the room in slow figure-eights.
description: The kind of bar that doesn't need a name over the door because if you're here, you already knew where you were going. SUMP is scratched into the paint anyway. It is one narrow room, a plank bar, and a floor that slopes toward a literal drain in the center — hence the name, and hence the smell. The regulars are fixtures, welded to their stools by decades of gravity and grievance. Drinks are cheap, strong, and served without conversation.
name: Sump
